# Fixes v0.20.6 must carry. Format: module | commit | note
#
#   module  = "conduit" for this repository, or a Go module path resolved in go.mod
#   commit  = SHA of at least 7 hex digits; must be an ancestor of the module's
#             pinned version (or of HEAD for "conduit")
#   note    = short description. release_notes_check.py requires every note (or
#             the commit's 7-character prefix) to appear in the `## Fixed`
#             section of docs/releases/v0.20.6.md, so keep it verbatim.
#
# A patch release (Z > 0) must have at least one entry, and at least one entry
# that is NEW since v0.20.5 (its commit is not already in that tag). A list of
# old commits does not pass. Verify before tagging with:
#     make release-check TAG=v0.20.6
#
# Nothing below is final yet: the v0.20.6 fixes are still landing on this
# branch, so every line is a commented placeholder. As each merge lands,
# uncomment its line and replace <sha> with the final squash SHA on this
# branch. The gate fails closed on a commit that is not an ancestor, so leave
# a line commented until its SHA actually exists here. The private-fork fixes
# get their real SHA from the advisory fork's squash merge, not from the
# pre-squash fork commit (a fork SHA such as 506c3630 is not an ancestor after
# squash).

# Engine — API exposure (localhost default, token off-loopback, origin/host/UI
# token checks, utilities-server auth):
# conduit | <squash-sha> | bind the API to localhost by default and require a token off-loopback

# Engine — misuse via the API (env.allow, file/JS directory allowlists, plugin
# env minimal):
# conduit | <squash-sha> | restrict plugin environment and file and JavaScript access to allowlists

# Engine — server-side request forgery (outbound HTTP guarded at dial time):
# conduit | <squash-sha> | guard outbound HTTP at dial time against the egress allowlist

# Engine — log connector metadata-only:
# conduit | <squash-sha> | make the log connector metadata-only by default

# Engine — file source complete-lines follower and fail-loud rotation:
# conduit | <squash-sha> | follow complete lines only and fail loudly on rotation

# Engine — default-DLQ refusal (pipeline.dlq_not_recoverable):
# conduit | <squash-sha> | refuse to start a pipeline with no recoverable DLQ

# Toolchain — Go 1.26.10 for GO-2026-6809 (backport of the go.mod bump):
# conduit | <squash-sha> | bump the Go toolchain to 1.26.10 for GO-2026-6809

# Engine — sanitized-error hardening (record values, keys, URLs out of errors
# and logs):
# conduit | <squash-sha> | keep record values, keys, and URLs out of errors and logs

# Postgres — slot-gap fail-loud. Bump go.mod to conduit-connector-postgres
# v0.14.6, then uncomment with the fix commit in that repo (an ancestor of the
# v0.14.6 tag):
# github.com/conduitio/conduit-connector-postgres | <sha> | fail loudly when the replication slot no longer covers the saved position
